scope: A masked retrospective test of four explicitly named local-rule candidates in the complete public ADB Z-surname export; not a representative population or full traditional-system validation.
birth_selection: Apply frozen birth qualification, all R5 identity exclusions and pre-outcome family-component representative selection. Use all remaining eligible records, without sampling on death age or cause.
family_selection: Within each rating, select lexicographically smallest blinded study_id in each known Family relationship component. Unknown relationships do not imply unrelatedness.

endpoint.case: Documented death on or after 20th birthday date and before 60th birthday date.
endpoint.control: Documented survival to 60th birthday date, established by a death date at/after 60 or independently recorded evidence of being alive at/after 60.
endpoint.exclude: Documented death before 20; never use absence of a death record as evidence of survival.
endpoint.unknown: Unresolved or contradictory status, incomplete death date, or no affirmative survival evidence.
endpoint.source_coding: Accept only the subject's own Death event with a complete Gregorian date; deaths of relatives or partners are not outcomes. Conflicting subject-death dates are unknown. Absence of death is not survival. Posthumous awards, publications or memorials do not establish survival.
endpoint.cross_source_check: After score sealing, the custodian may check exact unique-linked QIDs using all non-deprecated P569/P570 values and precision. Conflicts become unknown; absent QIDs or missing P570 do not overturn an unambiguous ADB death event. Report single-source, concordant and conflicting counts separately; AA applies to birth evidence only.
endpoint.birthday_convention: Civil Gregorian date, with February 29 anniversaries on March 1 in a non-leap anniversary year. No fabricated time of death.
endpoint.unknown_outcomes: Report all missingness. Complete-observed-outcome analysis is conditional on ascertainment and cannot establish population risk; do not fill unknown labels.

score_meaning: Each component normalized to [0,1] using frozen rule denominators 1,2,1,4; ENSEMBLE is their unweighted arithmetic mean. Scores are not probabilities.
direction: Higher score hypothesized to accompany more deaths between 20 and 60; reverse associations do not validate that direction.
model_training: None; no fitting, threshold optimization, feature selection or calibration with this sample.
score_abstention: Every birth-qualified ID must retain a baseline prediction record. If any fixed component is unavailable, explicitly mark ABSTAIN with no imputed score; report the number and exclude that record from score-outcome comparison without using its outcome to select it. Do not treat an abstention as low risk. For a clock stress point, report unavailable comparisons rather than silently changing the baseline observed comparison set.
primary_statistic: Pooled within-stratum pair-weighted AUC. Stratum = floor(birth_year/20)*20 x sex x birth_country. Only strata with both observed endpoint classes contribute comparison pairs.
null: Within these strata, outcome labels are exchangeable with respect to the fixed score. This observational exchangeability assumption does not remove all confounding or selection bias.

permutation.calculation: (1 + permutations with absolute centered U at least observed)/(draws + 1)
permutation.constant_score: AUC=0.5 and p=1 if outcome comparison pairs exist; no pairs or one outcome class => statistic and p null.

multiplicity: Holm adjustment across 10 predeclared baseline tests: five scores in AA and five in A. Nonestimable tests occupy a slot with p=1. Overall two-sided family alpha=0.05. AA is primary; A is separately labeled secondary.
descriptive_effect: Unadjusted selected-sample 2x2 odds ratio for any-positive score versus zero, with Fisher conditional 95% interval when estimable. It is descriptive and unadjusted, not a population mortality estimate or separate confirmatory decision.
clock_sensitivity: Evaluate the same rules at -120,-30,+30,+120 minutes with local and UTC time shifted consistently. Report score changes and AUC descriptively, no extra significance claims. These are four hypothetical stress points, not measured uncertainty or exhaustive bounds over the interval.
no_adaptive_repair: If a defect is found before label interpretation, version and re-freeze with reason. After outcomes are interpreted, retain the result and classify any correction as post-reveal; no relabeling this sample as fresh blind validation.
independence: Outcome-custodian role separated from rule construction and analysis implementation; shared workspace provides procedural masking, not enforced access isolation or independent external replication.
reporting: Report birth-qualified, family-selected, scored, outcome-observed and informative-pair counts separately; event counts never inferred from file row counts. Preserve null results, errors and exclusions.
